Reviewer: rater1
Response date: 2026-09-20
Scope: Final targeted response on the five remaining items.

1. D002 and D004: I cannot resolve the distinction between an imprecise description of the retained interval list and an unsupported gap-detection assertion. I agree to retain Pending adjudication (E03) for each item as the final disposition.

2. D024: I agree to retain Pending adjudication (E02) for the ambiguous use of “significant.” E04 is withdrawn and is not reopened.

3. “Within median” — RA857737CABCC0FB8 / I001 and RDB18B7C593D48194 / I002: I do not accept the proposed wording rule as sufficient to clear these two statements. Correct interval placement does not resolve whether “within the median” is faulty coordination or a mistaken comparison. I agree to retain Pending adjudication (E01) for both reports, with one issue group per report. The repeated statements within RDB18B7C593D48194 belong to the same group.

These Pending dispositions preserve unresolved interpretations and do not count as confirmed errors. No further full review is requested. This response confirms rater1’s position only; three-rater agreement requires the other two raters’ explicit confirmation.
